sentences.en: The barrage was the most devastating in a series of recent rocket attacks on Kabul by the Western-backed mujahedin.

sentences.en: Television stations say just before the first blast in Ahmedabad they had received a 14-page long e-mail warning of an attack from a group calling itself "Indian Mujahedin."
